summary.value: Amelie Bistro & Wine Bar is a French bistro and wine bar on Amsterdam Avenue on the Upper West Side, built around small plates and a long wine list. Restaurantji diners call it The best restaurant on the UWS, single out beef tartare, salade nicoise, moules-frites, burger as favorites, and say the staff make you feel at home the moment you walk in. It suits an early evening drink and snack or a relaxed neighborhood dinner.

description.value: Amelie Bistro & Wine Bar is a French wine bar and bistro on Amsterdam Avenue, serving small plates and more than 90 wines. Its happy hour runs every day, 4 to 6 pm. Deals include $14 wine flights and $10 wine of the day. Representative Tripadvisor praise (traveler reviews, search snapshot): “Amazing selection of reasonably priced wines, knowledgeable waitstaff.”. Representative watch-outs: “the place is so noisy that it is hard to have a conversation”. Restaurantji shows 4.3 263 ratings for the 566 Amsterdam Avenue bistro. A Restaurantji regular adds that Happy hour 4-6pm with $1.5 oysters and other delicious options and $14 wine flights is incredible, and another sums it up as Great vibe. The mussels were excellent.
